'''Mantooine''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]], on the [[Relgim Run/Legends|Relgim Run]]. The people of Mantooine distrusted outsiders and government, particularly the totalitarian [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the [[Mantooine Liberators]] were [[Battle on Mantooine/Legends|decimated]] by Imperial forces, the [[Fest Resistance Group]] united with the Liberators to form the [[Atrivis Resistance Group/Legends|Atrivis Resistance Group]], which allied with the pan-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and became its [[Atrivis Sector Force]].

==History==
Mantooine, along with [[Sestooine]] in the northern quadrant, was colonized during the onset of the [[Kymoodon Era]].<ref name="TEA" /> During its history, Mantooine was constantly at war with neighboring planet [[Fest/Legends|Fest]].<ref name="RAS" />

Soon before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the local resistance group, known as the [[Mantooine Liberators]], [[Battle on Mantooine/Legends|assaulted]] and captured the local [[Imperial garrison post]]. However, Mantooine was immediately attacked in retaliation by an Imperial strike fleet from the [[Fest system/Legends|Fest system]]. For complex historical reasons, the Mantooine Liberators were not in contact with the [[Fest Resistance Group]] and the people of Fest was not able to warn Mantooine before the Liberators were decimated. Ultimately, this event led the two planets found common cause in their conflict with the Empire, and the combination of the Mantooine Liberators with the Fest Resistance Group formed the [[Atrivis Resistance Group/Legends|Atrivis Resistance Group]]. They would later join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="RAS" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] destroyed the [[Imperial orbital base]] above Mantooine during [[Operation Cobolt]].<ref name="RAS" />

The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] later named a [[Mantooine (CR90 corvette)|ship]] after the world.<ref name="IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>

The ''[[Mantooine Minuet]]'' was presumably from the world, as was [[Brandei]].
